test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.**

The South Indian dish was __approved by the guests__ as it was tasty.
solution: The correct answer is "**accepted by the visitors**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the **meaning** of the given **words**. • **accepted**: regard favorably or with approval; welcome. (अनुकूल रूप से या अनुमोदन के साथ; स्वागत। ) • **gratified**: give (someone) pleasure or satisfaction. ((किसी को) सुख या संतुष्टि देना।) • **doomed**: likely to have an unfortunate and inescapable outcome; ill-fated. (एक दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण और अपरिहार्य परिणाम होने की संभावना; बदकिस्मत। ) • **condemned**: officially declared unfit for use. (आधिकारिक तौर पर उपयोग के लिए अनुपयुक्त घोषित किया गया। ) • **Options 2, 3, and 4 **are **not suitable** for the underlined part in the given sentence as per the **meaning **of the **given words**. • As per the meaning of the given words, "accepted" is the word that can improve the underlined sentence. • The meaning of the given sentence is that the South Indian dish was liked and regarded favorably by the visitors. **The correct sentence is**: *The South Indian dish was** ****accepted by the visitors__** as it was tasty.* Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.** 4d:T9fd, The correct answer is "**an upset**"
